ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (light grey/white) pixel distribution occurring as fine-grained mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation across both lobes with high-frequency, low-area light-pixel mottling. Highly textured, high-contrast clusters are localized at the distal terminals of both the left and right fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 85 degrees and a medium depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge, characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel-level variations (peaks and valleys).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curvature originating from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent, highly textured white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, high-contrast textured clusters (barnacles) at both distal tips, creating irregular physical boundaries at the terminals.
